_comment: OSCAL4Rail example upstream manifest for the BSI 'Stand-der-Technik-Bibliothek' (CC-BY-SA-4.0). Single source of truth for the pinned upstream used by examples/profiles/. Follows the same reproducible-acquisition policy as schemas/nist/manifest.json (ADR-008): we DO NOT vendor these files into the repo; we fetch them from a pinned source and verify SHA256. The BSI repository publishes no release tags, so we pin on a commit SHA instead of a release tag. To bump: change 'commit', re-run tools/fetch_bsi_example.py --update-manifest, review the diff, commit.
